entries.name: TE-8105
entries.stage: Phase 2b record posted; not yet recruiting; estimated October 2026 start
entries.summary: Immunwork's sponsor-submitted NCT07857473 record describes TE-8105 as an injectable GLP-1 receptor agonist in a randomized, placebo-controlled Phase 2b study for adults with overweight or obesity. The record plans three subcutaneous dose-escalation cohorts, 25 weeks of treatment and up to 204 participants at two listed Australian locations.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed registry evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation or UK clinical-trial authorisation for TE-8105.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed research evidence.
entries.supply: A planned Australian clinical study does not establish lawful UK retail supply, pharmacy stock, expanded access or sale by Shift Some Timber.
entries.limitations: The record was first posted on 5 October 2026 and remains not yet recruiting. Its October 2026 start, 204-participant enrolment and February 2028 completion are estimates, not completed dosing, actual enrolment or results. Two Australian facilities are listed, but the record does not establish that either is actively recruiting. No results are posted. The study's safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetic, body-weight, body-composition and metabolic assessments do not establish efficacy, safety, an approved dose, a less-frequent regimen, superiority or clinical benefit. This entry does not transfer evidence from earlier TE-8105 research or sponsor announcements to this Phase 2b study.

discoveryPass.method: A separate first pass checked the live configured-source monitor, overdue reviews and open review work. A current-date ClinicalTrials.gov pass then searched obesity and overweight records updated on 4-5 October, followed by current-date and broader sponsor/topic searches across named and additional developers.
discoveryPass.included: NCT07857473 was first posted on 5 October 2026 and was absent from the 100-programme live catalogue and dated receipts. The complete registry body supports one bounded TE-8105 Phase 2b entry and lifecycle monitor.
discoveryPass.notDuplicated: No open Medicines Watch pull request or live entry contains TE-8105. Existing GLP-1 programmes and earlier-stage studies remain separate evidence and are not used to inflate this entry.
incompleteChecks: The registry does not establish recruitment, first dosing, actual enrolment, results, UK marketing authorisation, NICE/NHS access or UK supply; no such fact is inferred.
